BiblicalUsage: Helbon is named in the lament over Tyre as the source of the wine Damascus trades, the wine of Helbon with white wool. It is a place known for its vineyards, named once in the trade list of the nations.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts the wine of Helbon among the riches of Tyre, and the lament over the city names what it traded before it fell.
